title: A Lift to the Clinic
transcript: A volunteer group has begun offering free rides to medical appointments in three small villages. The service is intended for people who do not have a car or a regular bus connection. Passengers must request a ride at least two days in advance. The drivers use their own cars, and a local business pays for their fuel. The group already has enough drivers for weekday mornings, but it is looking for people who are free in the afternoons.

questions.prompt: Who is the transport service designed to help?
options: People who work at medical clinics.
questions.explanation: 服务面向没有车或没有固定公交连接的村民。

questions.prompt: How much notice is needed to book a ride?
questions.explanation: at least two days in advance 表示至少提前两天。
